title: An overpayment-only loan chargeback credits the FUND_SOURCE 250.00 and debits OVERPAYMENT 250.00 (loan 19 L99)
_note: Parity vector transcribing the TWO-LEG journal entry a loan CHARGEBACK posted on a loan that is NOT charged off, the overpayment-only shape, on the Tier-D MNT replay (throwaway tenant `tierd`, currency MNT, 2 minor digits, product LP1 / product 6) at the chargeback transaction. request.chargeback_journal.amount is the accepted chargeback request transactionAmount 250.0 -> "25000" minor units, raised with paymentTypeId 2 (loans/loan-19/loan-19-chargeback-request.json); transaction_id L99 is the journal entries' transaction id for the read-back's transaction id 99 (type loanTransactionType.chargeback, which follows a 500.00 repayment that left a 250.00 overpayment). request.chargeback_journal.portions transcribes the loan read-back's chargeback transaction id 99 after the chargeback: principalPortion absent -> "0", overpaymentPortion 250.0 -> "25000"; the observed identity amount = principal + overpayment holds (25000 = 0 + 25000). request.chargeback_journal.accounts is the product's slot->GL-account-id mapping read back from the accepted create request product-mappings/create-request-LP1.json: fundSourceAccountId 4, loanPortfolioAccountId 10, overpaymentLiabilityAccountId 18; paymentTypeId 2 has no channel mapping, so the default FUND_SOURCE 4 applies. expect.chargeback_journal_legs is a TRANSCRIPTION of the two L99 legs in id order: JE 218 CREDIT account 4 250.0, JE 219 DEBIT account 18 250.0. THIS VECTOR GRADES ONE PROPERTY: a chargeback credits the amount to the resolved fund source and debits the OVERPAYMENT portion to OVERPAYMENT, in posting order. It is the shape that discriminates the registered drive loan-wrong-chargeback-journal-overpayment-to-portfolio: a port that reuses LOAN_PORTFOLIO for the overpayment portion moves the debit from account 18 to account 10, which this vector's account cell sees. Nothing was computed by this promotion: every amount, every account and every expected leg is read directly from the committed files.
